text:
release-lead-maya: Heads-up: EU change window opens in 20m. This thread is the single source for the freeze/unfreeze plan and readiness checklist. Please ack and call out any outstanding items.
eng-oncall: ack. Oncall handoff done, runbook loaded.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Preflight checks started at 3187659999. canary pool healthy. CI artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/3187/artifacts :white_check_mark:
sre-ali: Perf thresholds posted in infra SLOs. Auto-unfreeze disabled for this window. Manual unfreeze only.
docs-sam: Release notes + changelog pushed to Console and the docs site. Included migration notes for schema v5 -> v6. Link: https://docs.internal/release/3187
support-mei: Support playbook updated with explainer and contact points. Pager assigned to two engineers for 60m post-pin.
release-lead-maya: Freeze checklist highlights: pin approvals, canary p50/p95 targets, rollback cmd tested, infra throttle knobs verified. Anything missing?
sre-ali: Quick double-check: KV cache warmers scheduled, no hot keys on EU slice. GPU headroom at 68%.
eng-oncall: Confirmed `deploy rollback --to v1.9.7` path works in staging. Dry-run passed.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout: 10% -> 30% now. Metrics stream: https://metrics.internal/c/anom/3187659999
support-mei: Noting customer comms draft is queued if we need an emergency rollback.
release-lead-maya: Decision point: if p99 latency on any route exceeds baseline +35% for 3 consecutive mins, we pause and consider partial rollback. Thresholds documented in ticket RT-3187.
docs-sam: Also added the rollback notice template to #status-updates.
sre-ali: Observing small spike on embeddings p99 (baseline 550ms -> 750ms). Investigating sequence length distribution.
eng-oncall: No errors in Sentry yet. Traffic shaping stable.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Pausing at 30% by automated safety hold because embeddings p99 exceeded configured threshold. Pause reason: embeddings tail spike.
release-lead-maya: Hold traffic at 30%. Do not pin yet. Triage owners: @sre-ali perf, @eng-oncall infra warming, @docs-sam comms.
sre-ali: Quick trace shows rare quant kernel fallback on long sequences. I'll patch quant-config on canary pool (hotfix branch queued). ETA ~9m.
docs-sam: Drafting a short internal note on the observed tail regression and mitigation steps.
eng-oncall: Running targeted A/B with sequence-length cap to validate hypothesis.
support-mei: Keeping support channel open and monitoring tickets.
release-lead-maya: If hotfix reduces p99 to within baseline+15% within 12m, we resume and pin. If not, execute partial rollback for embeddings service only.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Hotfix roll command issued to canary nodes:
```
opsctl apply --service embeddings --patch quant-config-hotfix --pool canary
```
sre-ali: After patch p99 trending down: 750 -> 610 -> 580 over 7m. Looks within acceptable range now.
eng-oncall: KV preloads also stabilized. No increased cache miss.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Resuming rollout to 70% now. ETA ~4m.
sre-ali: Monitoring p99 across EU and global slices; no customer errors observed.
docs-sam: Final release note includes hotfix summary and rollback instructions.
support-mei: Support ready for 60m watch after pin — pager rotation in place.
release-lead-maya: OK resume to 100% over next 5m, then pin to v1.10.0. Post-pin watch 45m. Remember: no auto-unfreeze for 45m. Team ack to proceed?
sre-ali: ack.
eng-oncall: ack.
docs-sam: ack.
support-mei: ack.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rolling to 100% starting now.
release-lead-maya: Pinning command ready: `deploy pin v1.10.0 --reason "EU change window 3187659999"`
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Pin applied. Version v1.10.0 pinned across prod.
release-lead-maya: Pin complete. Starting 45m post-pin watch. If we see any customer-visible regression, open a sev1 and follow the rollback runbook.
sre-ali: Noted. I have a dashboard alert set for p99 > baseline+20%.
support-mei: Notifying customer success for heads-up email if anything changes.
release-lead-maya: Great work. Closing thread after green 45m. Leave any follow-ups as replies here. :white_check_mark:
